Who we are

About GMR Mechanical Repairs

GMR Mechanical Repairs is a local automotive workshop on Leland Street, Penrith, carrying out log book servicing, mechanical repairs, auto electrical work and rego inspections on cars, SUVs, 4WDs and light trucks. Straight answers, honest assessments, and work done right the first time.

  • Log book servicing
  • Rego inspections
  • Auto electrical
